# Forgenta

> Forgenta is a budget app for iOS, Android and the web by TRE Forged LLC. It shows what is safe to spend until payday: the lowest your checking balance will reach before payday after every bill, minus a cash floor, with pending card swipes counted. It also forecasts cash month by month and plans debt payoff (avalanche or snowball, with a debt-free date). There is a free plan; Premium is $9.99 a month or $89.99 a year.

## Product pages
- [Best budget app](https://getforgenta.com/best-budget-app/): how budget apps differ, with prices
- [Simple budget app](https://getforgenta.com/simple-budget-app/): one number before payday, three-step setup
- [Free budget app](https://getforgenta.com/free-budget-app/): what the free plan includes
- [Safe to spend](https://getforgenta.com/safe-to-spend/): how much you can spend before payday, worked example
